title: Granularity of affine-subspace indicators
statement: Let $H$ be a linear subspace of the $n$-dimensional vector space over $ bf_2$, and let $a$ be a vector in that space. The indicator function of the affine subspace $a+H$ is vector Fourier granular with granularity $2^{-\operatorname{codim}(H)}$, meaning that each Fourier coefficient of the corresponding function on the sign cube is an integer multiple of this number.
